name: Invisible Stalker
languages: understands Common but doesn't speak it

traits.name: Damage Resistances
traits.description: Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.description: The stalker is invisible. (Innate Invisibility, CONTENT_CONVENTIONS §44: the Invisible condition, with no duration and no concentration. Attacking or casting does not end it. Spell Invisibility's ends_on is unchanged. Faultless Tracker is not this trait. See Invisibility, Faerie Fire outlined, and Branding Smite reveal_invisible versus a permanent holder are not decided. The built-in AI is not changed. Whether Invisible needs a Combat::hash tag is not decided. Heard or noticed hiding is not modelled.)

traits.name: Faultless Tracker
traits.description: The stalker is given a quarry by its summoner. The stalker knows the direction and distance to its quarry as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence. The stalker also knows the location of its summoner. (Descriptive only: Faultless Tracker is not innate_invisibility and is not a tracking mechanic. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.description: The stalker makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
